name: Anneliese Ziegler
bio:
Anneliese Ziegler's passion for motorsport ignited at a young age, fueled by weekend trips to the Nürburgring with her father. After earning a degree in aerospace engineering from RWTH Aachen University, she started her career at a small wind tunnel facility, meticulously honing her understanding of aerodynamics. Her expertise quickly caught the attention of several Formula teams, but Anneliese always felt a pull towards the more gritty and hands-on world of touring cars. 

She joined Erebus Motorsport a decade ago, initially as a senior aerodynamicist, swiftly rising to Head of Aero. Her approach is marked by a relentless pursuit of marginal gains, a keen eye for detail, and a willingness to challenge conventional wisdom. Known for her pragmatic solutions and her ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, Anneliese is a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Anneliese is of average height, with a focused gaze that suggests she is constantly analyzing the world around her.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches and calculations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on brewing her own strong black coffee every morning, claiming it's essential for peak performance.
